name: StateHouse Holdings Inc.
summary: StateHouse Holdings Inc. operates as a vertically integrated enterprise within the U.S. cannabis sector, encompassing cultivation, processing, manufacturing, distribution, and direct retail sales of its products. The company caters to both the adult recreational and medical cannabis markets. Its retail network comprises 13 dispensaries throughout California, along with one location in Oregon, including a notable outlet situated in San Francisco's iconic Haight Ashbury district. This organization, previously known as Harborside Inc., rebranded to StateHouse Holdings Inc. in July 2022. Its corporate headquarters are located in San Diego, California.
